note: The closed list of values a story may teach. A story names one to three of these keys in stories/modes.json, the main value first, and one English sentence `shows` that names the action which shows it. A story shows a value by what a character does. No line says what a child must do. The nine values marked with a date were confirmed on 2026-11-05. The other keys are taught by the 16 stories that were finished before that day. Religious content is not a value and is refused by config/content-lint.json.

calm.name: Calm and rest
calm.means: Settling down, a bedtime routine, breathing slowly.

comfort.name: Comfort
comfort.means: Sitting with someone who is sad or hurt, and staying until it passes.

regulation.name: Handling a big feeling
regulation.means: Anger or frustration, then breathe, then try again.

joy.name: Joy
joy.means: A glad moment with someone you love, shared out loud.

belonging.name: Belonging
belonging.means: Family love. A child who is loved without conditions.

teamwork.name: Teamwork
teamwork.means: Everyone has a job and the day works because of it.

inclusion.name: Inclusion
inclusion.means: Welcoming a newcomer and making room.

curiosity.name: Curiosity
curiosity.means: Discovering something and wanting to look again.

honesty.name: Honesty
honesty.means: Telling the truth, and owning a mistake, before anyone asks.

sorry.name: Saying sorry and forgiving
sorry.means: Saying sorry after an accident, and answering with forgiveness and a repair.

sharing.name: Sharing and taking turns
sharing.means: One thing, two children. They wait and take turns.

respect.name: Respect: ask first, gentle hands
respect.means: Asking before taking, and touching softly.

kindness.name: Helping a friend
kindness.means: Seeing that a friend needs help and helping without being asked.

patience.name: Patience and trying again
patience.means: Waiting, and trying again after it did not work.

gratitude.name: Gratitude
gratitude.means: Saying thank you and noticing what others did.

courage.name: Courage with someone near
courage.means: A fear is named, shared and faced a small step at a time.

nature.name: Care for nature and animals
nature.means: Gentle hands with plants and small animals.
